description: Infrastructure acceptance test; excluded from model-quality conclusions.
prompt: Create a file named eval-smoke.txt in the repository root containing exactly EVAL_SMOKE_OK followed by one newline. Do not change any other file.

source.notes: Synthetic acceptance task. It is not part of the real-traffic evaluation set.

oracles.name: exact-file-content
command: test "$(git status --short | wc -l)" -eq 1 && test "$(git status --short)" = '?? eval-smoke.txt' && test "$(cat eval-smoke.txt)" = EVAL_SMOKE_OK
